description: Repeated validation of selected immutable server providers on a retained start
environment: Linux x86-64 host with production Java provider installers and RuntimeReadPolicy counters. Android context and assets were supplied by the filesystem qualification facade. No pacing or pressure injection.

The control uses the same private canonical test directories and pinned runtime archive. SQL and server work are outside the interval.
